results.title: Sudurpaschim seek first win as Pokhara begin NPL campaign
results.content: Runners-up in the first two editions, Sudurpaschim face a Pokhara side yet to reach the playoffs as the latter open their third Nepal Premier League campaign.

results.title: A 228-metre leap above Nepal’s Kaligandaki gorge
results.content: The suspension bridge linking Kushma and Balewa has become a popular destination for adventure seekers, drawing hundreds of visitors a day to try bungee jumping or watch others take the plunge.

results.title: Could Rahul Yadav be Nepali cricket’s next big thing?
results.content: A wicket with his first NPL delivery and a miserly four-over spell have put the 17-year-old in the spotlight.

results.title: Users turn to Nepal Telecom as private ISPs raise internet prices
results.content: The state-owned provider’s discounted annual 30 Mbps fibre package has drawn a surge of interest, but customers have raised concerns about delays, service quality and outdated routers.

results.title: Why Nepali film sequels are struggling at the box office
results.content: From 12 Gaun to Jaari, recent follow-ups have failed to repeat their originals’ commercial success, with critics pointing to recycled plots and an overreliance on popular names.

results.title: Malaysia halts recruitment of Nepali workers amid manpower agency dispute
results.content: Malaysia suspended biomedical health screenings for new Nepali migrants on October 1, effectively halting calling visas after Nepal rejected Kuala Lumpur’s policy restricting recruitment to 25 primary manpower agencies.

results.title: Nepali worker’s death in Saudi Arabia leaves family deep in debt
results.content: Bharat Mahato’s earnings had sustained his household and financed a new home. Now his wife is left to raise four children and repay Rs1.1 million loan.

results.title: Nuwakot flood victims form struggle committee to pressure federal government for help
results.content: Victims decry the lackadaisical approach from Kathmandu to the resettlement of displaced people, only prolonging their plight.

results.title: Karnali Yaks stun Janakpur Bolts with late bowling collapse
results.content: Unish Bikram Singh Thakuri and Hussain Talat take three wickets each as Karnali defend 132 to begin their Nepal Premier League campaign with a 19-run win.

results.title: Roads around Kirtipur cricket ground to be blacktopped within three months
results.content: The Kathmandu Road Division has invited bids for upgrading 1.5km of access roads at an estimated cost of Rs69.8 million, ahead of international cricket tournaments.

results.title: Janakpur bowlers restrict Karnali to 132
results.content: Captain Harmeet Singh takes three wickets as Karnali Yaks lose nine wickets in their 20 overs in the Nepal Premier League.

results.title: Kathmandu Valley to consume 5.18 million flower garlands this Tihar
results.content: Domestic growers are expected to meet nearly 89 percent of demand as the festival’s flower trade, including plants and potted chrysanthemums, approaches Rs645 million.

results.title: Nepali lawmaker faces privacy backlash over videos of children filmed with smart glasses
results.content: Ashika Tamang blurred a child’s face after criticism, but rights advocates say her videos raise wider questions about consent and the responsibilities of elected representatives.

results.title: Budhigandaki needs commitment, not another new plan
results.content: Repeated shifts in financing and implementation have delayed Nepal’s largest reservoir project.

results.title: Who does Nepal Police serve?
results.content: Is police power guided by law, evidence and accountable command, or by obedience to whoever happens to hold power?

results.title: Drones came after Lirung. Nepal needs them before the next collapse
results.content: In Nepal, researchers still need permission for each project to use drones that monitor dangerous slopes before they fail.

results.title: The NPL is on, but fans in Achham can’t get a signal
results.content: As the tournament unfolds in Kathmandu, supporters in remote villages are travelling to nearby settlements and market centres to watch their teams.

results.title: Nepal gives 35 days to agency owners yet to respond to arrest warrants
results.content: The Department of Foreign Employment warns of banking and travel restrictions for those who fail to report, as it investigates Malaysia’s selection of 25 Nepali recruitment agencies.
